device_template.name: Deye single-phase hybrid inverter (read-only)
device_template.author: Stefan Maldaianu
device_template.description: Deye single-phase low-voltage hybrid inverter (SUN-xK-SG0xLP1 family, e.g. SUN-8K-SG05LP1-EU), mostly READ-ONLY (FC03 holding registers): every telemetry row is read-only, and the only writable registers are the four battery/grid-charge set points behind the optional commands set_max_charge_current (210), set_max_discharge_current (211), set_grid_charge_current (230) and grid_charge (232) — all disabled by default, each written as a single FC16 register (the template never sets single_register_writes), so nothing is written until an admin enables a command on a device. Wire the inverter's RS485 "Modbus" port (not the BMS/CAN port, not the Wi-Fi logger port), Modbus RTU 9600 8N1, unit ID 1. Reads identity and serial, the running state, PV1/PV2 voltage, current and power, grid voltage, current, frequency and power, the inverter and load power, battery voltage, current, power, SOC and temperature, the GEN port (an AC-coupled microinverter there: its power, voltage and daily and total energy), the BMS block as the inverter receives it (voltage, current, temperature, SOC, charge/discharge current limits and voltages), the battery type and rated capacity settings, the load voltage, daily and total energies as counters, the inverter temperatures and the warning/fault words (bits named by the Fxx code the display shows). 32-bit totals are low word first, so the template's word order is little (CDAB); the total grid import is split across 78 and 80 (79 is the frequency) and is rebuilt as the calculated energy_active_import. Signs follow the gateway's canonical conventions: battery_power and battery_current + charging (Deye reports + discharging, so both are inverted with a negative scale), power_grid + import / - export (as Deye reports it), power_load negative = consuming (inverted). First checked on hardware on a SUN-8K-SG05LP1 (2026-10-27, no BMS connected): the rows that agreed say so, the rest are still to be verified on site against the inverter display. Version 0.4.0 adds the inverter's settings block as read-only rows (battery charge/discharge limits and SOC/voltage thresholds, grid charging, energy pattern, work mode and export, the time-of-use table, the special-functions word with the lithium-loss fault bit, the real-time clock, the grid-connected flag, the BMS alarm/fault flags and the selected BMS protocol) so the operator sees today's values; they are read, never written, and are all still to be checked on hardware.
device_template.source_document: Deye single-phase hybrid Modbus map as published by the ha-solarman project (deye_hybrid.yaml, SUN-xK-SG01LP1/SG03LP1/SG05LP1) and cross-read against kellerza/sunsynk (src/sunsynk/definitions/single_phase.py: the same Deye/Sunsynk single-phase firmware; there a negative factor marks a signed register, not an inversion) and Deye's 'Modbus RTU protocol' for single-phase energy storage inverters. Reference only, no code copied. Checked on a SUN-8K-SG05LP1 (protocol 0x0201) on 2026-10-27; each row says whether it was. The GEN port, BMS block and battery settings (0.3.0) come from the same maps; the BMS temperature (319) from the Deye document only.

notes.text: Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): a write was issued and read back, and the change was confirmed on the inverter (Solarman).
Not yet checked on hardware: built and validated, but no write has been issued to the inverter. Each needs a bench write with the operator before it is considered verified.

Partly checked on hardware (SUN-8K-SG05LP1, 2026-10-27, no BMS): identity, state, grid (GRID port and CT), load, PV, battery voltage/current/power, temperatures and the energy totals agreed, and the inverter display confirmed the signs and totals. Rows marked 'Not yet checked on hardware' (SOC and battery temperature with a BMS, inverter output power and current, rated power, serial, warning and fault words, and the GEN port, BMS block, battery settings, load voltage and cumulative production rows, whose display readings are noted) still need comparing with a register read. The 0.4.0 settings block (battery limits and thresholds, grid charging, work mode and export, the time-of-use table, the special-functions word, the clock, the BMS alarm/fault flags and the BMS protocol) is read-only and entirely 'Not yet checked on hardware' yet: read it on the Pi5 and compare with the inverter display (or the Solarman app).

A set of optional write commands is available (the battery current limits 210/211, grid charge current 230 and grid charging on/off 232, work mode and export settings, the grid-charge start SOC 229 and voltage 228, and the six time-of-use slots 250-273), all disabled by default and guarded (single-phase device type, and lithium battery for the current limits and protection setpoints). Each command carries a note saying whether it has been checked on hardware. Battery operation mode (213) and the battery shutdown/restart/low thresholds (217-222) are deliberately read-only. Writing a setting over Modbus changes the inverter’s stored settings, so each command stays off until an admin enables it on a device and unlocks writes.
Wiring: the RS485 'Modbus' port, 9600 8N1, unit 1. The BMS port (RS485/CAN) talks to the battery and the logger port to the Wi-Fi stick; do not connect there.

Signs: battery_power and battery_current are + while charging (Deye reports + discharging, - charging; the bench read raw -244 W while PV charged the battery); power_grid is + importing; power_load is negative while the loads consume, as every power_load in the gateway (the inverter shows the same figure positive).
The total grid import sits in registers 78 (low word) and 80 (high word), with the frequency in 79 between them; energy_active_import is calculated from the two, which are read but not published.

Grid: power_grid (169) is the power through the inverter's GRID port, measured inside the inverter. grid_ct_power (172) is the external CT at the site's meter: the whole site's exchange where a CT is fitted, noise near 0 where none is (the bench read 1572 W at 169 and 24 W at 172). The inverter display confirmed both (2026-10-27 09:31).

GEN port: an AC-coupled microinverter (or a generator, or a smart load) on the GEN port shows in gen_power, gen_voltage, gen_energy_today and gen_energy_total (calculated from 92 low and 95 high). energy_lifetime ('Cumulative Production (Active)') is the PV total plus the GEN total; energy_active_generated stays the PV total.

How a BMS loss shows on this model (bench, BMS disconnected, 2026-10-27): SOC 0, battery temperature raw 0 (published as absent), the running state still Normal (vendor_state 2) and no alarm, while battery voltage, current and power keep reading from the inverter's own sensors. Nothing in the state or alarm rows flags it, so a consumer (the ADR-0023 work) must read SOC 0 together with an absent battery temperature as 'BMS lost', not as an empty battery.

The BMS block (312-321) is what the inverter receives from its BMS, next to its own battery measurements (183, 184, 182, 190, 191): for ADR-0023 it shows whether the BMS link carries data. With the BMS disconnected the display shows the whole block at 0 and its temperature at -100; bms_voltage, bms_temperature and the two BMS voltages are then absent (0 V and -100 °C cannot be real), while currents, limits and SOC stay 0 (a BMS may send 0).

Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 22.11830 MWh on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: gen_power
registers.label: GEN port power (microinverter)
registers.description: 166 (0x00A6). Power through the GEN port, W, signed ('Gen power' / 'AUX power'; the negative factor in kellerza marks a signed register). With an AC-coupled microinverter on the GEN port this is its output ('MI Power' on the display), + while it produces; the sign is still to be confirmed in daylight. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 W on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: power_grid
registers.label: Grid power (inverter GRID port)
registers.description: 169 (0x00A9). Power through the inverter's GRID port, W, measured inside the inverter. Deye: + buying, - selling, already the gateway's power_grid convention (negative = exporting): no inversion. This is the grid exchange the inverter itself sees; on a site with an external CT at the meter, grid_ct_power (172) is the exchange of the whole site. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-10-27): +1572 W while importing, equal to the load fed through the inverter. The inverter display (2026-10-27 09:31) confirmed it: 169 is the GRID-port power ('Grid Tie Power' 0 W at 09:31), not the external CT.

registers.name: grid_ct_power
registers.label: Grid power (external CT)
registers.description: 172 (0x00AC). Power at the external CT ('Grid CT power' in the Sunsynk map), W, same sign as power_grid (+ import). Without an external CT it reads noise near 0 (24 W on the bench, which has none). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-10-27): 24 W on the bench with no CT fitted; the inverter display's 'Total CT Power' (30 W at 09:31) is this register, so 172 is the external CT.

registers.name: power_active_total
registers.label: Inverter power
registers.description: 175 (0x00AF). Inverter AC output power, W (+ = the inverter delivers AC). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: verify on site against the inverter display.

registers.name: power_load
registers.label: Load power (− consuming)
registers.description: 178 (0x00B2). Total load power on the inverter's LOAD port, W ('Load power' / 'Total Load Power' in the published maps; Deye reports it + while consuming). Published inverted, negative while consuming, as the canonical power_load (canonical_fields: 'House load (negative = consuming)', the Fronius P_Load convention). Loads wired between an external CT and the inverter are not in it. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-10-27): 1573 W of load, published -1573.

registers.label: GEN port voltage
registers.description: 181 (0x00B5). Voltage on the GEN port, 0.1 V ('MI Voltage' on the display with a microinverter there). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 226.60 V on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.label: Battery temperature
registers.description: 182 (0x00B6). Battery temperature, 0.1 °C with a +100 °C offset: (raw - 1000) / 10. Raw 0 (which would read -100 °C) means no BMS or no sensor and is published as absent. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: verify on site against the inverter display.

registers.name: soc
registers.label: Battery SOC
registers.description: 184 (0x00B8). Battery state of charge, %, as the BMS reports it. Reads 0 with no BMS connected (see the notes). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: verify on site against the inverter display.

registers.name: power_dc_mppt1
registers.label: PV1 power
registers.description: 186 (0x00BA). PV1 power, W. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-10-27): 115 W.

registers.name: power_dc_mppt2
registers.label: PV2 power
registers.description: 187 (0x00BB). PV2 power, W. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-10-27): 181 W.

registers.name: battery_power
registers.label: Battery power
registers.description: 190 (0x00BE). Battery power, W, signed. Deye: + discharging, - charging. Inverted (scale -1) to the gateway's battery_power convention (+ charging). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-10-27): raw -189 and -244 while PV charged the battery, published +189 / +244. The inverter display (2026-10-27 09:31) confirmed it: charging is raw negative.

registers.name: battery_current
registers.label: Battery current
registers.description: 191 (0x00BF). Battery current, 0.01 A, signed. Deye: + discharging, - charging. Inverted (scale -100) to the gateway's battery_current convention (+ charging). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-10-27): raw -362 and -467 while charging, published +3.62 / +4.67 A. The inverter display (2026-10-27 09:31) confirmed it: charging is raw negative.

registers.name: battery_type
registers.label: Battery type
registers.description: 200 (0x00C8). Battery type / control mode setting: 0 lead-acid (four-stage charging), 1 lithium (charging under the BMS). A setting, read only. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read lithium on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: battery_rated_capacity
registers.label: Battery rated capacity
registers.description: 204 (0x00CC). Battery capacity setting, Ah ('Battery Rated Capacity' on the display). The value set on the inverter, not a BMS measurement. A setting, read only. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 500 Ah on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: charge_voltage_limit
registers.label: BMS charge voltage
registers.description: 312 (0x0138). Charge voltage the BMS asks for, as the inverter receives it, 0.01 V ('Battery charging voltage' / 'BMS Charging Voltage'). Raw 0 (no BMS) is absent. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: discharge_voltage_limit
registers.label: BMS discharge voltage
registers.description: 313 (0x0139). Discharge cut-off voltage the BMS sends, as the inverter receives it, 0.01 V. Raw 0 (no BMS) is absent. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: charge_current_limit
registers.label: BMS charge current limit
registers.description: 314 (0x013A). Charge current limit the BMS sends, A ('Battery charge limit current' / 'BMS Charging Current'). 0 is a valid limit (a full battery), so it is kept. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: discharge_current_limit
registers.label: BMS discharge current limit
registers.description: 315 (0x013B). Discharge current limit the BMS sends, A ('Battery discharge limit current' / 'BMS Discharging Current'). 0 is a valid limit, so it is kept. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml + kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map. Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: bms_soc
registers.label: BMS SOC
registers.description: 316 (0x013C). State of charge as the BMS sends it, %. Kept at 0 with no BMS (as 184 is); read it together with bms_voltage absent as 'BMS lost'. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: bms_voltage
registers.label: BMS voltage
registers.description: 317 (0x013D). Pack voltage as the BMS sends it, 0.01 V (pack_voltage, 183, is the inverter's own measurement). Raw 0 (no BMS) is absent. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: bms_current
registers.label: BMS current
registers.description: 318 (0x013E). Pack current as the BMS sends it, A, signed, published as received (its sign convention is the BMS's; battery_current, 191, is the inverter's own measurement in the canonical + charging). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read 0 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: bms_temperature
registers.label: BMS temperature
registers.description: 319 (0x013F). Battery temperature as the BMS sends it, 0.1 °C with a +100 °C offset: (raw - 1000) / 10. Raw 0 (no BMS) would read -100 °C and is published as absent. Source: the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the ha-solarman or kellerza/sunsynk maps); the display's -100 with the BMS disconnected agrees with raw 0 through the same +100 degC offset as 182. Not yet checked on hardware: the inverter display read -100 (BMS disconnected) on 2026-10-27 09:31; compare with a register read.

registers.name: bms_max_charge_current
registers.label: BMS max charge current
registers.description: 320 (0x0140). Maximum charge current the BMS reports, A ('BMS Max Charging Current'). Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and the Deye single-phase Modbus document (not in the kellerza/sunsynk single-phase map). registers.name: bms_max_discharge_current

registers.name: rtc_year_month
registers.label: Inverter clock (year/month)
registers.description: 22 (0x0016). Inverter real-time clock: high byte year (20YY), low byte month. The TOU program runs on this clock, so it is read for context. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py (SystemTime). Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 2026-11 (raw 6667 = 0x1A0B).

registers.name: rtc_day_hour
registers.label: Inverter clock (day/hour)
registers.description: 23 (0x0017). Inverter real-time clock: high byte day, low byte hour. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): day 03, hour 09 (raw 777 = 0x0309).

registers.name: rtc_minute_second
registers.label: Inverter clock (minute/second)
registers.description: 24 (0x0018). Inverter real-time clock: high byte minute, low byte second. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml and kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): minute 27, second 29 (raw 6941 = 0x1B1D); the inverter clock matched real time.

registers.name: bms_interface_flags
registers.label: BMS interface flags
registers.description: 100 (0x0064). Other test flags. Bit 8 = lithium battery interface on RS485, bit 9 = on CAN; a test register, so it is read to see which BMS link is live, not relied on. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118) (test register; to verify). Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): CAN interface selected; the Deye is off the BMS-CAN link, so this is the configured interface, not a live link.

registers.name: grid_connected
registers.label: Grid connected
registers.description: 194 (0x00C2). 1 while the inverter is tied to the grid, 0 off-grid. Source: ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): Grid connected.

registers.name: battery_equalization_voltage
registers.label: Battery equalization voltage
registers.description: 201 (0x00C9). Lead-acid equalization voltage, 0.01 V (used in lead-acid mode, 200 = 0). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Not yet checked on hardware: read on the Pi5 and compare with the inverter display.

registers.name: battery_absorption_voltage
registers.label: Battery absorption voltage
registers.description: 202 (0x00CA). Lead-acid absorption voltage, 0.01 V (lead-acid mode). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Not yet checked on hardware: read on the Pi5 and compare with the inverter display.

registers.name: battery_float_voltage
registers.label: Battery float voltage
registers.description: 203 (0x00CB). Lead-acid float voltage, 0.01 V (lead-acid mode). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Not yet checked on hardware: read on the Pi5 and compare with the inverter display.

registers.name: zero_export_power
registers.label: Zero-export power target
registers.description: 206 (0x00CE). Grid draw target in a zero-export work mode, W, signed (kellerza -500..+500; ha-solarman configurable). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 25 W.

registers.name: battery_max_charge_current
registers.label: Battery max charge current
registers.description: 210 (0x00D2). 'Max A Charge' setting, 0-185 A (Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118)/kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py; ha-solarman says 0-240; datasheet 190 A). A persisted setting. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 180 A (also written 180->10->30->180 over RS485, each read-back verified).

registers.name: battery_max_discharge_current
registers.label: Battery max discharge current
registers.description: 211 (0x00D3). 'Max A Discharge' setting, 0-185 A (ha-solarman 0-240). A persisted setting. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 90 A.

registers.name: battery_operation_mode
registers.label: Battery operation mode
registers.description: 213 (0x00D5). How the inverter drives the battery: 0 by voltage, 1 by capacity (SOC), 2 no battery. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): By capacity (SOC).

registers.name: battery_wake_up
registers.label: Battery wake-up
registers.description: 214 (0x00D6). Battery wake-up: 0 enabled, 1 disabled. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): Disabled.

registers.name: battery_shutdown_soc
registers.label: Battery shutdown SOC
registers.description: 217 (0x00D9). SOC at which the inverter shuts the battery down, % (invariant shutdown < low < restart). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 5 %.

registers.name: battery_restart_soc
registers.label: Battery restart SOC
registers.description: 218 (0x00DA). SOC at which the inverter restarts the battery, %. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 50 %.

registers.name: battery_low_soc
registers.label: Battery low SOC
registers.description: 219 (0x00DB). Low-battery SOC warning threshold, %. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 5 %.

registers.name: battery_shutdown_voltage
registers.label: Battery shutdown voltage
registers.description: 220 (0x00DC). Shutdown voltage in voltage mode (213 = 0), 0.01 V (D1 default 41 V). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 46.0 V.

registers.name: battery_restart_voltage
registers.label: Battery restart voltage
registers.description: 221 (0x00DD). Restart voltage in voltage mode, 0.01 V (D1 default 52 V). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 52.0 V.

registers.name: battery_low_voltage
registers.label: Battery low voltage
registers.description: 222 (0x00DE). Low-battery voltage in voltage mode, 0.01 V (D1 default 46 V). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 47.0 V.

registers.name: grid_charge_start_voltage
registers.label: Grid charge start voltage
registers.description: 228 (0x00E4). Battery voltage below which the inverter charges from the grid, 0.01 V. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 49.0 V.

registers.name: grid_charge_start_soc
registers.label: Grid charge start SOC
registers.description: 229 (0x00E5). Battery SOC below which the inverter charges from the grid, %. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 30 %.

registers.name: grid_charge_current
registers.label: Grid charge current
registers.description: 230 (0x00E6). Current used when charging from the grid, 0-185 A (kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py max 185; ha-solarman 0-240). Acts only when grid charging is enabled (232). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py, ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 50 A.

registers.name: grid_charge_enable
registers.label: Grid charging
registers.description: 232 (0x00E8). Charge the battery from the grid: 0 off, 1 on. Grid charging happens inside a TOU slot whose grid-charge bit is set (274-279 bit0). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): On.

registers.name: gen_port_mode
registers.label: GEN port mode
registers.description: 235 (0x00EB). What the GEN port drives: 0 generator, 1 smart load, 2 micro-inverter (explains the GEN-port rows). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): Micro-inverter (matches the GEN-port microinverter).

registers.name: battery_charge_priority
registers.label: Energy pattern (battery/load first)
registers.description: 243 (0x00F3). Energy pattern: 0 battery first, 1 load first. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): Battery first.

registers.name: work_mode
registers.label: Work mode (grid export)
registers.description: 244 (0x00F4). Limit-control / work mode: 0 selling first (export first), 1 zero export to load (built-in CT), 2 zero export to CT (external). Changes the whole energy flow. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): Zero export to load.

registers.name: max_sell_power
registers.label: Max sell power (export limit)
registers.description: 245 (0x00F5). Maximum power the inverter exports to the grid, W (D1 0-8000; ha-solarman 0-12000). The grid-code export cap. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): 8000 W.

registers.name: solar_sell
registers.label: Solar sell
registers.description: 247 (0x00F7). Sell surplus PV to the grid: 0 off, 1 on. kellerza notes enabling it draws a constant ~40 W. Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): Off.

registers.name: tou_enable

registers.description: 248 (0x00F8). TOU program: bit0 enable, bits 1-7 Mon-Sun, bit8 'work mode 3 (Spain)'. Written as a full word (no read-modify-write in the engine). Source: Deye single-phase Modbus document (V118), ha-solarman deye_hybrid.yaml, kellerza/sunsynk single_phase.py. Checked on hardware (SG05LP1, 2026-11-03): Enabled, all days.

rules.label: Charge the battery from surplus — keep the grid at ~0 (MBG-controlled)
rules.description: Closed-loop grid regulator: the signal is the grid export (negative grid CT power). While the house exports over 50 W it RAISES the max charge current so the battery soaks the surplus; while it imports over 50 W it lowers it; within +/-50 W of zero it holds. This self-limits — as the charge current rises, export falls and the signal falls, so it settles at grid ~0 — unlike a PV-minus-load signal, which does not include the battery and so cannot self-limit (FINDINGS DEYE-CTRL-1). Targets set_max_charge_current (reg 210) over RS485. START IN SHADOW: confirm the grid CT sign and placement on the bench before arming, and tune the dead band and gain. In strict zero-export the firmware already holds the grid near zero, so this rule mostly holds and only acts if export appears; its clearer home is an export-enabled or grid-charge setup. Reg 210 is an EEPROM setting; the closed loop re-commands only on drift and the 60 s channel pace keep writes rare — a bench demonstration of the control logic, not a permanent sub-minute regulator (the production knob is the BMS-CAN charge-current limit, ADR-0039). NOT ARMED by default: like every preset it is offered in shadow and is only armed once a write budget for reg 210 is agreed (design §2) — the channel is paced at 600 s and the loop writes only on read-back drift.

rules.label: Stop charging at a SOC ceiling (MBG-controlled)
rules.description: Protective charge ceiling: while the battery SOC is at or above 95 % it asks set_max_charge_current (reg 210) for 0 A, so charging stops; it releases when SOC falls back under 90 % (a 5-point hysteresis band). It runs in the SAFETY layer, above the charge_from_excess trim on the same battery_limits channel, so the trim regulates under this cap and this cap wins when the battery is full. Below the ceiling the rule abstains (else = no opinion) and leaves the current to a lower layer. on_stale = 0 fails closed (no charge while the SOC reading is stale). START IN SHADOW; tune the 95/90 band to the pack, and raise it toward the BMS's own limit. Reg 210 is an EEPROM setting, so the condition re-commands only on change and the channel pace keeps writes rare.

rules.label: Charge from the grid only in a time window (MBG-controlled)
rules.description: Time-of-use grid charging done with an MBG schedule instead of the inverter's TOU program: it sets set_grid_charge_current (reg 230) to a charge rate inside an off-peak window and back to 0 A outside it. The example charges at 40 A from 01:00 and stops at 06:00, every day -- edit the windows, the rate and the days. This is the RS485-native alternative to arming a TOU slot, which needs the slot enable (248) and the per-slot grid-charge flag bit (274-279) -- single-bit (masked) writes that are not in this engine yet. For the grid to actually charge the battery the inverter must have grid charging armed (a TOU slot with its grid-charge bit set, plus grid_charge_enable); with that off this rule only moves reg 230 and nothing flows. START IN SHADOW. Reg 230 is an EEPROM setting, so the schedule writes only when the active window changes (a few times a day).

rules.label: Grid-charge off a SOC floor when the house load is low (MBG-controlled)
rules.description: A worked example of a load-aware floor protection: when the battery SOC drops below 15 % AND the house load averaged over ~1 h (load_ema_1h) is under 2000 W, it enables grid charging at 10 A via grid_charge_control; it keeps charging until SOC recovers over 20 % (hysteresis), then turns grid charging off. Below the floor but with a high recent load it waits, so it does not pull from the grid during heavy demand. The 1 h figure is an exponential moving average (ema(load, 3600)), not a fixed-window mean. It runs in the SAFETY layer on the grid_charge channel (paced at 300 s). on_stale/on_disable fall back to the command's safe params (grid charge off). IMPORTANT: for the inverter to actually draw from the grid a TOU slot's grid-charge bit must be set (on Solarman, or a future masked write) -- with it off this rule still decides and writes enable/current, but no grid power flows. START IN SHADOW; adapt the 15/20 % floor, the 2000 W load gate and the 10 A rate to the site. This is one example; a template can ship several.
